name: Action Boy/Girl
summary: Taking an extra major action with AP no longer raises the difficulty of the second action.

name: Adamantium Skeleton
summary: Enemies need 1 more damage per rank to inflict a critical hit on you.

name: Adrenalin Rush
summary: While below maximum health, your STR counts as 10 for STR-based skill tests and melee attacks.

name: Animal Friend
summary: Mammals, lizards and insects may decide not to attack you; at rank 2 you can befriend one with a CHA + Survival test.

name: Aquaboy/Aquagirl
summary: No radiation from swimming and longer breath-holding; at rank 2 you are harder to detect underwater.

name: Armorer
summary: Lets you install armor mods; each rank unlocks the next rank of mods.

name: Awareness
summary: After aiming at a target at Close range, your next attack on it gains Piercing 1 (or +1 Piercing).

name: Barbarian
summary: Physical DR on all locations rises with your STR (+1 at 7–8, +2 at 9–10, +3 at 11+); not while in Power Armor.

name: Basher
summary: Bashing with your gun gains the Vicious damage effect.

name: Better Criticals
summary: Spend 1 Luck point after dealing damage to turn the hit into a critical hit.

name: Big Leagues
summary: Two-handed melee weapons gain the Vicious damage effect.

name: Black Widow/Lady Killer
summary: Against characters of the chosen gender: re-roll 1d20 on CHA tests to influence them and +1 CD damage.

name: Blacksmith
summary: Lets you install melee weapon mods; each rank unlocks the next rank of mods.

name: Blitz
summary: Moving into reach and attacking in melee in the same turn lets you re-roll 1d20; at rank 2 also +1 CD damage.

name: Bloody Mess
summary: A critical hit may inflict an extra injury on a random location (roll 1 CD for an Effect).

name: Can Do!
summary: Scavenging a location with food yields one extra random food item for free.

name: Cap Collector
summary: Raise or lower prices by 10% when buying or selling.

name: Cautious Nature
summary: Re-roll 1d20 on a skill test when you buy d20s with your own AP; cannot be combined with Daring Nature.

name: Center Mass
summary: Target the Torso with a ranged attack without extra difficulty, and re-roll 1d20 on that attack.

name: Chem Resistant
summary: Roll fewer dice for chem addiction; at rank 2 you cannot become addicted to chems.

name: Chemist
summary: Your crafted chems last twice as long, and chem recipes that need this perk become available.

name: Commando
summary: +1 CD damage per rank with ranged weapons of Fire Rate 3 or more (not heavy weapons).

name: Comprehension
summary: After using a magazine bonus, a CD Effect lets you use it once more.

name: Concentrated Fire
summary: When spending extra ammo for damage on a ranged attack, re-roll up to 3 CD.

name: Daring Nature
summary: Re-roll 1d20 on a skill test when you buy d20s by giving the GM AP; cannot be combined with Cautious Nature.

name: Demolition Expert
summary: Blast weapons gain the Vicious damage effect, and explosive recipes that need this perk become available.

name: Dodger
summary: The Defend action gets easier by 1; at rank 2 raising Defense further costs only 1 AP.

name: Dogmeat
summary: You have a loyal dog as an allied NPC companion that grows with your level.

name: Entomologist
summary: Attacks against Insect NPCs gain Piercing 1 (or +1 Piercing).

name: Fast Metabolism
summary: +1 HP per rank whenever you regain HP from anything but rest.

name: Faster Healing
summary: The first extra d20 on END + Survival tests to heal your own injuries is free.

name: Finesse
summary: Once per combat, re-roll all CD of one damage roll without spending Luck.

name: Fortune Finder
summary: Find more caps when rolling for money: +3, +6 or +10 CD by rank.

name: Ghost
summary: The first extra d20 on AGI + Sneak tests in shadows or darkness is free.

name: Grim Reaper’s Sprint
summary: When an attack kills an enemy, a CD Effect adds 2 AP to the group pool.

name: Gun Fu
summary: After a successful ranged attack, spend AP and ammo to hit up to one additional nearby target per rank.

name: Gun Nut
summary: Lets you install small gun and heavy weapon mods; each rank unlocks the next rank of mods.

name: Gunslinger
summary: +1 CD damage per rank with one-handed ranged weapons of Fire Rate 2 or less, and re-roll the hit location.

name: Hacker
summary: Hacking computers is 1 difficulty easier.

name: Healer
summary: First Aid heals +1 HP per rank.

name: Heave Ho!
summary: Spend 1 AP to increase a thrown weapon's range by one step.

name: Hunter
summary: Attacks on mutated mammals, lizards and insects gain the Vicious damage effect.

name: Infiltrator
summary: Re-roll 1d20 on Lockpick tests to open doors and containers.

name: Inspirational
summary: The group can save 1 more AP.

name: Intense Training
summary: Raise one S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attribute of your choice by 1 per rank, to at most 10.

name: Iron Fist
summary: Unarmed attacks deal +1 CD; at rank 2 they also gain the Vicious damage effect.

name: Junktown Jerky Vendor
summary: CHA + Barter tests to buy or sell are 1 difficulty easier.

name: Jury Rigging
summary: Repair items without components; the repair breaks on the next complication and raises the complication range.

name: Laser Commander
summary: +1 CD damage per rank with ranged energy weapons.

name: Lead Belly
summary: Re-roll the radiation check for irradiated food and drink; at rank 2 you are immune to it.

name: Life Giver
summary: Maximum HP increases by your END per rank.

name: Light Step
summary: Spend AP to ignore complications on AGI tests, and re-roll 1d20 to avoid pressure-plate traps.

name: Master Thief
summary: Others find it 1 difficulty harder to notice you picking locks or pockets.

name: Medic
summary: Re-roll 1d20 when treating an injury with First Aid.

name: Meltdown
summary: Enemies killed with energy weapons explode and can damage creatures close to them.

name: Mister Sandman
summary: Sneak attacks with silenced or suppressed weapons deal +2 CD; not in Power Armor.

name: Moving Target
summary: Sprinting raises your Defense by 1 until your next turn.

name: Mysterious Stranger
summary: Spend 1 Luck at the start of combat and a stranger may appear to shoot an enemy once (Luck refunded if not).

name: Nerd Rage!
summary: Below a quarter of your maximum HP you gain +1 DR and +1 CD damage per rank.

name: Night Person
summary: Difficulty increases from darkness are reduced by 1.

name: Ninja
summary: Melee and unarmed sneak attacks deal +2 CD; not in Power Armor.

name: Nuclear Physicist
summary: Radiation weapons deal 1 more radiation damage per Effect, and your fusion cores hold 3 more charges.

name: Pain Train
summary: In Power Armor or as a super mutant, charge an enemy to damage and knock it prone; rank 2 adds damage and Stun.

name: Paralyzing Palm
summary: Unarmed attacks aimed at a specific location gain the Stun damage effect.

name: Party Boy/Party Girl
summary: You cannot get addicted to alcohol, and each alcoholic drink heals 2 HP.

name: Pathfinder
summary: A successful PER + Survival test halves long-distance travel time through the wilderness.

name: Pharma Farma
summary: Scavenging a location with medicine or chems yields one extra random item for free.

name: Pickpocket
summary: Better at stealing from people: ignore a complication, re-roll 1d20, and finally an easier difficulty by rank.

name: Piercing Strike
summary: Unarmed and bladed melee attacks gain Piercing 1 (or +1 Piercing).

name: Pyromaniac
summary: +1 CD damage per rank with fire-based weapons.

name: Quick Draw
summary: Draw one weapon or item each turn without a minor action.

name: Quick Hands
summary: Spend 2 AP to double your gun's Fire Rate for one attack.

name: Rad Resistance
summary: +1 radiation DR on all locations per rank.

name: Refractor
summary: +1 energy DR on all locations per rank.

name: Ricochet
summary: When an enemy's ranged attack on you complicates, spend 1 Luck to turn the damage back on them.

name: Rifleman
summary: +1 CD damage per rank with two-handed ranged weapons of Fire Rate 2 or less (not heavy weapons); rank 2 adds Piercing.

name: Robotics Expert
summary: Lets you mod robots; higher ranks make robot repairs easier and let you reprogram robots.

name: Science!
summary: Lets you install energy weapon mods and some advanced armor mods; each rank unlocks the next rank of mods.

name: Scoundrel
summary: Ignore the first complication on CHA + Speech tests to make someone believe a lie.

name: Scrapper
summary: Scrapping also yields uncommon components; at rank 2 rare ones too.

name: Scrounger
summary: Find more ammunition when rolling for it: +3, +6 or +10 CD shots by rank.

name: Shotgun Surgeon
summary: Shotgun attacks gain Piercing 1 (or +1 Piercing).

name: Skilled
summary: Add 1 rank to two skills, or 2 ranks to one skill (never above 6).

name: Size Matters
summary: +1 CD damage per rank with heavy weapons.

name: Slayer
summary: Spend 1 Luck after dealing unarmed or melee damage to inflict a critical hit.

name: Smooth Talker
summary: Re-roll 1d20 on Barter or Speech in opposed tests.

name: Snakeater
summary: +2 poison DR.

name: Sniper
summary: After aiming, a two-handed Accurate weapon may target a hit location without extra difficulty.

name: Solar Powered
summary: Heal 1 radiation damage for every hour in direct sunlight.

name: Steady Aim
summary: After aiming, re-roll 2d20 on your first attack this turn or 1d20 on all of them.

name: Strong Back
summary: +25 lbs. carry weight per rank.

name: Tag!
summary: Choose one more Tag skill; it gains 2 ranks (to at most 6).

name: Terrifying Presence
summary: Re-roll 1d20 on Speech tests to threaten; at rank 2 you can scare an enemy away in combat.

name: Toughness
summary: +1 physical DR on all locations per rank.

name: Blocker
summary: Against melee attacks, the DR matching the attack's damage type (Physical or Energy) counts +1 per rank.

name: Bullet Shield
summary: While wielding a big gun, +2 DR; +3 at rank 2, +4 at rank 3.

name: Gladiator
summary: One-handed melee weapons deal +1 CD damage per rank.

name: Incisor
summary: Melee weapons gain Piercing 1 per rank, or that much more on an existing Piercing rating.

name: Lock and Load
summary: Big guns with Fire Rate 2 or more get +1 Fire Rate per rank.

name: Martial Artist
summary: After a melee attack, another melee attack as extra major action costs 1 AP instead of 2.

name: Pack Rat
summary: Carried junk counts half its weight.

name: Scattershot
summary: After a ranged attack with a shotgun, another attack with the same shotgun as extra major action costs 1 AP instead of 2.

name: Sturdy Frame
summary: Worn armor (not Power Armor) counts three quarters of its weight, half at rank 2, a quarter at rank 3.

name: Archer
summary: Bows and crossbows deal +1 CD damage per rank.

name: Bow Before Me
summary: Bows and crossbows gain Piercing 1, or +1 on an existing Piercing rating.

name: Butcher’s Bounty
summary: When you butcher an animal, roll 1 CD per rank for extra portions of meat.

name: Crack Shot
summary: Aimed attacks with one-handed ranged weapons reach one range step further; at rank 2 the weapon is also Accurate.

name: Fire in the Hole
summary: Attacks with thrown Blast weapons have a base difficulty of 1 instead of 2.

name: Glow Sight
summary: +1 CD damage per rank against Glowing enemies.

name: Night Eyes
summary: Poor light and darkness do not raise the difficulty of tests to hide or avoid notice.

name: Cannibal
summary: Butcher dead humans (END + Survival, difficulty 0) for flesh that heals 4 HP but is irradiated; ghouls from rank 2, super mutants from rank 3. Can become an addiction; super mutants need no level for rank 1.

name: Cola Nut
summary: Nuka-Cola beverages restore twice the usual HP.

name: Dromedary
summary: Beverages move your thirst one step further towards quenched.

name: Fireproof
summary: +1 Energy DR per rank against fire-based weapons and weapons with Blast.

name: Ghoulish
summary: Radiation damage heals you 1 HP per 4 points (per 3 at rank 2, per 2 at rank 3); your maximum HP is still reduced.

name: Ironclad
summary: +1 Physical and Energy DR per rank while you wear armor (not Power Armor); robot armor does not count.

name: Natural Resistance
summary: Toxic fumes and sleeping rough no longer risk catching a disease.

name: Radicool
summary: With radiation damage of a quarter, half or three quarters of your maximum HP: re-roll 1, 2 or 3 d20 on STR tests and +1, +2 or +3 CD melee damage.

name: Revenant
summary: When revived, your attacks deal +2 CD damage for the rest of the scene or until you drop to 0 HP again.

name: Slow Metabolizer
summary: Food moves your hunger one step further towards full.

name: Thirst Quencher
summary: Dirty water no longer risks catching a disease.

name: Vaccinated
summary: Claw and bite damage from mammals, lizards and insects no longer risks catching a disease.

name: Bloodsucker
summary: Blood packs heal twice the HP and quench thirst by one step; Irradiated Blood rolls only 1 CD for radiation.

name: Responder
summary: Stabilizing a dying ally in combat wakes them without AP and heals them 2 HP next turn (4 HP for two turns at rank 2, 6 HP for three turns at rank 3).

name: Field Surgeon
summary: In a First Aid action, Stimpaks heal 3 HP per AP and RadAway removes 1 more radiation damage per AP.

name: Happy Go Lucky
summary: Your first alcoholic beverage in a scene restores 1 Luck point.

name: Healing Hands
summary: Stabilizing a dying ally in combat also removes radiation damage equal to your Medicine rank.

name: Overly Generous
summary: With radiation damage of a quarter of your maximum HP or more, your melee attacks gain Radioactive.

name: Spiritual Healer
summary: Stabilizing a dying ally heals you 1 HP; at rank 2 2 HP now and next turn, at rank 3 3 HP now and on your next two turns.

name: Suppressor
summary: After a successful attack, spend 1 AP: the enemy deals 1 CD less damage per rank until the end of its next turn.

name: Tenderizer
summary: After a hit, spend 1 AP: attacks against the enemy deal +1 CD damage per rank until the end of its next turn.

name: Licensed Plumber
summary: Pipe weapons you use are not Unreliable.

name: Power Patcher
summary: Repairing Power Armor restores 2 more HP (3 at rank 2, 4 at rank 3).

name: Power User
summary: Your fusion cores hold 3 more charges (6 at rank 2, 10 at rank 3).

name: Stabilized
summary: In Power Armor, re-roll 1d20 on Big Guns attacks, and big guns gain Piercing 1 (or +1 on an existing rating).

name: Born Survivor
summary: When damage would drop you below a quarter of your maximum HP, use a Stimpak automatically, once per scene per rank.

name: Dead Man Sprinting
summary: Below half your maximum HP, spend 1 AP to move one more zone when you Sprint.

name: Escape Artist
summary: Unseen at the start of your turn in combat, hide with AGI + Sneak (difficulty: enemies within Medium range); sprinting gives enemies no bonus to find you.

name: Evasive
summary: +1 Physical and Energy DR on all locations at AGI 7–8, +2 at 9–10, +3 at 11+; not while encumbered or in Power Armor.

name: Goat Legs
summary: +2 Physical DR per rank against falling damage.

name: Modern Renegade
summary: Successful unaimed attacks with one-handed ranged weapons give 1 extra AP per rank, which cannot be saved.

name: Secret Agent
summary: Stealth Boys last 1 more turn per rank.

name: Dry Nurse
summary: When you stabilize a dying ally with a Stimpak, roll 1 CD: on an Effect the Stimpak is not used up.

name: Junk Shield
summary: +1 Physical and Energy DR for every 5 junk you carry, at most your rank; not in Power Armor.

name: Mysterious Savior
summary: At the start of combat, spend 1 Luck point: the first time you are dying, the GM may have a stranger revive you with 4 HP (the point comes back if not).

name: Psychopath
summary: When you kill an enemy, roll 1 CD per rank; each Effect restores 1 Luck point.

name: Serendipity
summary: Below a third of your maximum HP, spend 1 Luck point before an attack on you is rolled to make it miss, up to your rank times per scene.

name: Storm Chaser
summary: In rain or a rad storm, regain 1 HP at the start of each combat turn; outside combat, half your Luck (rounded up) per hour of rain.
